chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Asad al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Wasiti narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn Yusuf al-Jarudi narrated to us. He said: Abu Ishaq al-Fazari narrated to us from Sufyan al-Thawri and al-A'mash, from Abdullah ibn al-Sa'ib, from Zadhan, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud. He said:
The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Indeed, Allah has roaming angels on the earth who deliver the greetings of peace from my nation to me.

key_terms.أمتي: My nation/community (ummah), referring to the Muslim community
key_terms.السلام: Greetings of peace (salaam), the salutations sent upon the Prophet
key_terms.ملائكة سياحين: Roaming angels, angels who travel across the earth

ai.seo_question: Are there angels who deliver our greetings to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) informed his companions that Allah has designated special angels who travel across the earth, collecting the salutations (salaam) that Muslims send upon the Prophet and delivering them to him. This hadith, narrated through Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, one of the earliest companions and a Quran authority, affirms the ongoing spiritual connection between the Prophet and his community even after his passing, and encourages believers to frequently send blessings and greetings upon the Prophet.
